elements.label: Trace detail side panel (flame graph, tabs, error stack)

pattern.description: The camera pushes in (~10% scale) on the trace detail side panel so the flame graph and error stack fill the frame, while the dimmed list view behind slides out of view; the tilted caption banner stays fixed.
pattern.why_premium: A smooth, slow push-in reframes the real product UI onto the one panel that matters, making dense trace data readable without cuts and keeping the caption locked as a stable anchor.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.screen', {scale: 1.1, xPercent: -2, yPercent: 2, transformOrigin: '60% 40%', duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); caption banner sits outside the scaled group and does not animate.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 27], [1, 1.1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the screenshot container with transformOrigin on the side panel; small translate via the same eased progress. No spring (camera-style ease).

notes: b02 (panel header) moves as part of the same scaled screen as b01, so it is not listed separately. Caption already reads 'metrics, traces' at the burst start, so it is static here. Energy ramps then cuts off sharply (abrupt end ~frame 3135), which may indicate a linear or ease-in tail.
